snippet.title: an idle game you control with your desktop... and your essays
snippet.description:
Game: Widget Idle
Coming to Windows, macOS, and Linux this November on Steam.

Your desktop is its controller. Every click, keypress, and mouse movement helps it grow. Widget Idle lives quietly in the corner of your desktop while you get on with the more important things in life. Now with a little extra happiness :)
